debate.why: Senate candidates John Deaton and Ed Markey take opposite sides on health care, war, energy and the Supreme Court, and they rebut each other directly.

exchanges.motion: Did you and AOC say we'd be dead in three years?
exchanges.a_side: The Green New Deal authors predicted doom that never came
exchanges.b_side: They predicted a crisis by 2030, and it's here
exchanges.take_hook: Are we all *dead* in three years?
exchanges.retention: The opening line, "We're supposed to be dead in three years according to you and AOC," stops the scroll. The viewer then waits to see if Markey can get out from under the doomsday claim, and the last line turns it around by saying the crisis is already here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We're supposed to be dead in three years according to you and AOC.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We just said that we'd have a crisis by the year 2030.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And by the way, we're living that crisis now.
